subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] mm: zswap: use stack requests for synchronous decompression

2026-10-13.patch_summary: This patch modifies the zswap decompression code to use stack requests instead of heap requests for synchronous decompression. This change is made to address a performance issue where low-priority loads could stall higher-priority ones due to serialization on the per-CPU decompression mutex. The patch takes advantage of the fact that synchronous algorithms can use on-stack requests, which eliminates the need for the zswap lock and reduces the load path depth. The change affects software compressors only, as asynchronous algorithms continue to use heap requests and the per-CPU request and mutex.
